task: Review RSP-16 implementation plan before coding: Cap revival portability and private persona boundary.
user_intent: Norven wants Cap revival to work across machine migration, multi-user setups, and path changes, while keeping Cap private identity material separate from the public RedCap workflow repository.
main_claim: This is a pre-implementation review. Cap proposes to implement only path/hash/boundary verification for RSP-16: no copying, migrating, editing, committing, or pushing private $CAP_HOME identity content.
changed_reality: No implementation change yet; gate required full Prism before implementation.
Existing files already include assets/docs/cap-revival-manual.md, assets/docs/cap-soul-loader.md, and runtime/core/soul_loader.py.
Proposed implementation will add assets/contracts/cap-revival-portability.json and extend soul-load with portability-check.
Proposed evidence will be assets/evidence/rsp/rsp-16-cap-revival-portability.json and scoped claim assets/evidence/rsp/rsp-16-claim.json.
implementation_plan: Add a contract describing allowed public evidence: existence, hash, counts, title, configured_path; forbidden: private body, secret-like raw lines, host-specific absolute path as only reference.

Extend runtime/core/soul_loader.py with portability_check that uses temp fixture CAP_HOME and HOME values to test $CAP_HOME and ~/.cap resolution, missing/empty/not-file/unreadable blocking, and evidence redaction.
Add a public repository leak scan over bounded RedCap public docs/contracts/evidence for fixture private body strings and secret fixture strings.
Connect runtime/bin/redcap soul-load portability-check and check_runner step soul-load-portability-check.
Generate RSP-16 evidence and completion claim with explicit non-goals.
risk_controls: Do not read, copy, or write actual private $CAP_HOME identity body for RSP-16 checks.
Use temporary fixture identity files for body-leak negative probes.
If real current identity is checked, only record path status, sha256, counts, title, and configured_path.
Do not put $CAP_HOME private text into public evidence.
Do not claim RedCap complete revival.
known_constraints: RSP-16 has a human decision boundary for private persona migration or copying.
This plan intentionally avoids private migration/copying and only implements verification.
If the plan would require reading or copying private identity body, mark concern/block and state the safe alternative.

file_access.purpose: Review RSP-16 public implementation plan only; do not read private identity body.
